quote: If you'd like to be a model provider and sell inference on OpenRouter, fill out our form to get started.
For OpenRouter to use the provider we must be able to pay for inference automatically. This can be done via auto top up or invoicing.
Normal routing: 95%+ uptime; Degraded status: 80-94% uptime -> receives lower priority; Down status: <80% uptime -> only used as fallback
Throughput is calculated as: output tokens / generation time, where generation time includes fetch latency (time from request to first server response), TTFT, and streaming time.
Auto Exacto ... runs by default on every tool-calling request ... Throughput -- providers falling more than 1.5 standard deviations below the median are deprioritized.
Benchmark accuracy -- ... median of per-endpoint scores over that window minus 2 standard deviations ... An endpoint scoring below the cutoff, or missing benchmark data entirely, is deprioritized.
Valid quantization values are: int4, int8, fp4, mxfp4, nvfp4, fp6, fp8, mxfp8, fp16, bf16, fp32.
OpenRouter charges a 5.5% ($0.80 minimum) fee when you purchase credits.
